agent_test_copy_check.name: agent_test_copy_check
agent_test_copy_check.value: not "agent"."test_copy" or ("agent"."kind" = 'client' and "agent"."template_id" is not null)

billing_statement_counts_check.name: billing_statement_counts_check
billing_statement_counts_check.value: "billing_statement"."credits_used" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."credits_included" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."extra_credits" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."credit_price" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."days_in_month" between 28 and 31

builder_session_target_check.name: builder_session_target_check
builder_session_target_check.value: ("builder_session"."kind" = 'agent' and "builder_session"."skill_id" is null) or ("builder_session"."kind" = 'skill' and "builder_session"."agent_id" is null)

contact_reachable_check.name: contact_reachable_check
contact_reachable_check.value: "contact"."phone" is not null or "contact"."whatsapp" is not null or "contact"."email" is not null

conversation_shape_check.name: conversation_shape_check
conversation_shape_check.value: ("conversation"."kind" = 'direct' and "conversation"."contact_id" is not null and "conversation"."external_id" is null) or ("conversation"."kind" = 'group' and "conversation"."external_id" is not null)

conversation_external_id_check.name: conversation_external_id_check
conversation_external_id_check.value: "conversation"."external_id" is null or length("conversation"."external_id") between 1 and 200

conversation_capture_check.name: conversation_capture_check
conversation_capture_check.value: jsonb_typeof("conversation"."capture") = 'object' and coalesce(jsonb_typeof("conversation"."capture"->'archive') = 'boolean', false) and coalesce("conversation"."capture"->>'attachments' in ('off', 'documents', 'all'), false) and case when jsonb_typeof("conversation"."capture"->'maxBytes') = 'number' then ("conversation"."capture"->>'maxBytes')::numeric between 1 and 33554432 else false end

inbox_item_undelivered_idx.name: inbox_item_undelivered_idx
inbox_item_undelivered_idx.where: "inbox_item"."status" = 'resolved' and "inbox_item"."run_id" is not null and "inbox_item"."run_received_at" is null

knowledge_chunk_source_ids_check.name: knowledge_chunk_source_ids_check
knowledge_chunk_source_ids_check.value: ("knowledge_chunk"."source_type" = 'entry' and "knowledge_chunk"."entry_id" is not null and "knowledge_chunk"."entry_version_id" is not null and "knowledge_chunk"."document_id" is null) or ("knowledge_chunk"."source_type" = 'document' and "knowledge_chunk"."document_id" is not null and "knowledge_chunk"."entry_id" is null)

ledger_account_note_author_check.name: ledger_account_note_author_check
ledger_account_note_author_check.value: ("ledger_account_note"."source" = 'agent' and "ledger_account_note"."agent_version_id" is not null and jsonb_array_length("ledger_account_note"."sources") > 0) or ("ledger_account_note"."source" <> 'agent' and "ledger_account_note"."user_id" is not null)

message_translation_step_check.name: message_translation_step_check
message_translation_step_check.value: "message_translation"."step_run_id" is null or ("message_translation"."run_id" is not null and "message_translation"."agent_version_id" is not null)

oversight_decision_input_check.name: oversight_decision_input_check
oversight_decision_input_check.value: ("oversight_decision"."action" = 'retry_with') = ("oversight_decision"."input_after" is not null) and ("oversight_decision"."input_before" is null or "oversight_decision"."action" = 'retry_with')

run_resume_check.name: run_resume_check
run_resume_check.value: "run"."resume_from" is null or "run"."retry_of" is not null

user_factor_shape_check.name: user_factor_shape_check
user_factor_shape_check.value:
("user_factor"."kind" = 'totp' and "user_factor"."twilio_factor_sid" is not null and "user_factor"."phone" is null)
        or ("user_factor"."kind" in ('sms', 'whatsapp') and "user_factor"."phone" is not null and "user_factor"."twilio_factor_sid" is null)

catalog_item_key_signature_key.name: catalog_item_key_signature_key
catalog_item_key_signature_key.where: "catalog_item"."key_signature" is not null and "catalog_item"."merged_into_id" is null

item_alias_key_check.name: item_alias_key_check
item_alias_key_check.value: "item_alias"."vendor_sku" is not null or "item_alias"."description_hash" is not null

quote_line_std_check.name: quote_line_std_check
quote_line_std_check.value: "quote_line"."unit_price_std" is null or "quote_line"."standard_uom" is not null

content_version_sizes.name: content_version_sizes
content_version_sizes.value:
length("content_version"."title") <= 200 and length("content_version"."description") <= 500
        and length("content_version"."body_md") <= 200000 and cardinality("content_version"."target_queries") <= 20

forum_reply_decided.name: forum_reply_decided
forum_reply_decided.value:
("forum_reply"."status" = 'waiting') = ("forum_reply"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("forum_reply"."decided_at" is null) = ("forum_reply"."decided_by_user_id" is null)

marketing_report_action_decided.name: marketing_report_action_decided
marketing_report_action_decided.value:
("marketing_report_action"."decision" = 'open') = ("marketing_report_action"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("marketing_report_action"."decided_at" is null) = ("marketing_report_action"."decided_by_user_id" is null)

site_event_ranges.name: site_event_ranges
site_event_ranges.value:
("site_event"."engaged_ms" is null or "site_event"."engaged_ms" between 0 and 3600000)
        and ("site_event"."scroll" is null or "site_event"."scroll" between 0 and 4)
        and ("site_event"."position" is null or "site_event"."position" between 0 and 100)

site_event_kind_fields.name: site_event_kind_fields
site_event_kind_fields.value:
case "site_event"."kind"
        when 'view' then "site_event"."source_group" is not null and "site_event"."device" is not null
        when 'engage' then "site_event"."engaged_ms" is not null and "site_event"."scroll" is not null
        when 'click' then "site_event"."target" is not null and "site_event"."position" is not null
        when 'form_seen' then "site_event"."form" is not null
        else false end

booking_decider_check.name: booking_decider_check
booking_decider_check.value: "booking"."decided_by" = 'person' and "booking"."user_id" is not null or "booking"."decided_by" <> 'person' and "booking"."agent_version_id" is not null

reconciliation_signed_off_check.name: reconciliation_signed_off_check
reconciliation_signed_off_check.value: ("reconciliation"."status" = 'signed_off') = ("reconciliation"."signed_off_by" is not null and "reconciliation"."signed_off_at" is not null)
